purpose: Intersects the UCP capability sets two pasted profiles advertise: keeps the capabilities named by both sides at their highest mutually supported dated version, applies each extension's requires bounds, prunes extensions whose parents did not survive, and reports profile-shape findings (canonical keys[] placement, namespace authority binding against the reversed schema host, dev.ucp.* release pinning, protocol version format). Verify-only: decides from the two pasted profile objects and never fetches profiles, leaf documents, or schemas.
